description: This file defines Express.js routes for session tracking, including listing, retrieving by ID, creating, updating, and deleting session tracking documents. It includes functions for normalizing session data, handling pagination, filtering, and caching.

methods.name: toNumber
methods.description: Converts various value types (Decimal128, string, number) to a plain JavaScript number, returning NaN if parsing fails.

methods.name: normalizeSessionDoc
methods.description: Normalizes session document fields to ensure numeric values are properly typed, especially total_cost, cost_history[].total_cost, and agent_costs.
